states.description: A Quest file exists under solve/quests with sealed doneWhen and frontier metric definitions ready to declare.
The Solver log contains the sealed declaration event and the Quest is open for measured attempts.
A supervised step has pinned the before metric and awaits a commit or abort.
The selected frontier is stalled at a rung that requires Quest-native system or frontier theory before another supervised or autonomous attempt can begin.
The Solver log contains system theory, frontier theory, selected theory, or theory result events that can be projected into durable Quest memory.
An attempt event has recorded before and after metrics, evidence, changeRef, and ladder movement.
A frontier exhausted the finite strategy ladder and has been parked.
The Quest doneWhen probe is true against live evidence and the Solver recorded SOLVED.
Every frontier is parked and the Solver recorded EXHAUSTED.

transitions.evidence: node scripts/solve.js step or run records the initial quest-declared event.
node scripts/solve.js step --id rolling-restart-core-stability writes a pending baseline with the before metric.
node scripts/solve.js step --id rolling-restart-core-stability returns THEORY REQUIRED when rung gates lack selected theory evidence.
node scripts/solve.js run --id rolling-restart-core-stability stops before invoking an executor when rung gates lack selected theory evidence.
node scripts/solve.js theory system|option|select appends Quest-native theory events.
node scripts/solve.js health --id rolling-restart-core-stability reports no blocking theory-required signal for the selected rung.
node scripts/solve.js step --id rolling-restart-core-stability --commit records the attempt event with a diff changeRef.
node scripts/solve.js step --id rolling-restart-core-stability --abort clears the pending baseline without an attempt event.
node scripts/solve.js run --id rolling-restart-core-stability executes loop cycles and records measured attempts.
The latest attempt is folded into state and the next step reselects an open frontier.
A measured attempt with theoryRef appends supported, falsified, or needs-rerun theory-result learning.
The attempt event is followed by a park event after the finite ladder reaches park.
The scheduler redirects to another open frontier in the same Quest.
The Solver records EXHAUSTED only when no open frontier remains.
The Solver records SOLVED only when the doneWhen probe returns done true.
The Solver re-measures doneWhen after commit and records SOLVED when live evidence satisfies it.

forbiddenTransitions.reason: Goalpost changes after declaration are recorded as violations, not accepted transitions.
Only live doneWhen evidence can close a Quest.
Attempt proof must be a resolvable diff artifact.
The widen-scope rung requires selected frontier theory before another supervised attempt begins.
The autonomous loop must stop at theory_required before invoking an executor or recording an attempt.
The model rung requires selected frontier theory, active system theory, and modelRef or modelNotApplicable evidence.

invariants.statement: The declaration event's doneWhen and frontier metric definitions match the Quest file for every later step.
Progress credit requires finite before and after metrics, an existing evidence artifact, and a resolvable diff changeRef.
SOLVED and EXHAUSTED are represented by Solver terminal state events and report projection.
Widen-scope and later rungs require selected frontier theory before supervised or autonomous attempts, and model rung commits require active system theory plus model evidence or modelNotApplicable.
